answer.text: The PM executes trades for the client
The PM provides non-binding advice; client decides AND executes

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Advisory role = non-binding advice; client takes decisions and executes. **The Trap:** Execution/discretion belongs to other models. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same definition in X-B. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Advisory mandates suit institutional clients with in-house dealing desks.
